description: Screens one practitioner and returns state license status and board discipline flags (only for states that are live; sandbox keys get SAMPLE data for every state), identity check against CMS NPPES, and exclusion screening (OIG LEIE, SAM.gov and the state Medicaid lists that are live), with an evidence receipt. Takes NPI + first name + last name + state; names that differ from the record block the result; they are not returned with a warning. The output lists which sources returned CLEAR and which did not. NOT_CHECKED and COULD_NOT_CHECK mean the source was not checked; they are not a clear result. It also shows the OFAC SDN list result by exact name (information only: a possible match is for review and never changes an exclusion result; not on the list is not a clearance). Each call costs money: it counts as one lookup against the key's quota or prepaid balance (1 check), the same as GET /api/v1/sanctions. Not covered: states that are not live, licenses of staff without an NPI (use screen_roster), anything not on the official lists. A possible match is a finding for a person to confirm with the official source. Needs an API key (Authorization: Bearer sw_live_… or sw_test_…); without one it returns an error that points to how_to_get_access.

first_name.description: The practitioner's first name, as on their license.

fresh.description: true skips the 120-day cache and queries the source again.

last_name.description: The practitioner's last name, as on their license.

license_number.description: Required for states verified live; the error detail shows the format.

profession.description: Clinical profession, to scope the board search.

state.description: Two-letter state code, or eNLC for the nursing compact (sample data only).
